test_name: Configuration Management - CM-6 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Research-Platform-050
Primary NIST family: Configuration Management (CM); evidence focus: CM-6.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: a non-production configuration exception has exceeded its planned review date by seven days. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
